title: HORNVALLMO pleated shade
description: HORNVALLMO pleated shade, white/top-down bottom-up, 34x51 ¼" This pleated blind can be mounted in any way for privacy and to filter the light coming in from outside. Pull from top to bottom or from bottom to top – or just cover a section in the middle of the window.
features: Highly recommended to attach to surfaces made of glass.
For window frames or surfaces not recommended for the adhesive, mount the brackets with screws using a drill or screwdriver. The brackets are prepared with small holes for this purpose.
To reposition or reuse on another window, remove adhesive-mounted brackets with plastic hand scraper. Replace with new brackets available cost-free at stores or contact Customer Services for help.
For door windows or windows taller than 51⅛", mount 2 pleated blinds to cover the whole surface.
The top rail of the 34" wide blind can be cut max. 11.8".
If you need to adapt the dimensions of the pleated blind to your window, cut the top/bottom rails and the rods with a metal saw. Cut the fabric with a safety knife.
The included tool makes it easier to get straight, accurate lines when adapting the size of your rail/rod/fabric. It also protects your fingers.
For a smooth, friction-free glide, apply a few drops of silicone spray lubricant to the lock mechanism in the brackets. Ensure the spray is suitable for plastic and metal.
Can also be used in bathrooms.
materialAndCare: Fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Top rail/ Bottom rail: Aluminium (min. 70% recycled), Powder coating; Rod: Stainless steel, Powder coating; Lamella seat lock: Polyamide, ABS plastic, Reinforced polyamide; Handle: ABS plastic; Tool: Polypropylene
